def.name: apply-extract-digital-passport-credential
def.description: Implement the OpenSpec change 'extract-digital-passport-credential' task-group by task-group. Each loop iteration picks the lowest-numbered task group that still has unchecked sub-tasks, applies it, marks its checkboxes done, and loops until every task group is complete.

phases.task:
You are implementing OpenSpec change "{args.change}" in this repository (working directory = repo root).

Your ONE job this iteration: apply the change ONE task-group at a time.

A "task group" is a top-level numbered section heading in tasks.md (e.g. "## 1. Spike: ...", "## 2. Workspace scaffold", ... up to "## 7. Repository docs and boundary handoff"). Each group contains sub-tasks marked `- [ ]` (pending) or `- [x]` (done).

STEPS (follow strictly):
1. Read the apply skill file `.agents/skills/openspec-apply-change/SKILL.md` and follow its workflow.
2. Read the change's context files: {args.changeRoot}/{args.change}/proposal.md, {args.changeRoot}/{args.change}/design.md, {args.changeRoot}/{args.change}/tasks.md, and every spec under {args.changeRoot}/{args.change}/specs/*/spec.md.
3. Run `openspec status --change "{args.change}" --json` and `openspec instructions apply --change "{args.change}" --json` to get authoritative progress and apply instructions. If the `openspec` CLI is unavailable in your environment, fall back to reading tasks.md directly.
4. Determine the NEXT task group to apply: the LOWEST-numbered group in tasks.md that still has at least one unchecked sub-task (`- [ ]`). If every group is fully checked, you are done.
5. Implement ALL sub-tasks of that one group. Keep changes minimal and scoped to that group. Do NOT jump ahead to later groups. When you finish each sub-task, flip its checkbox in tasks.md from `- [ ]` to `- [x]`.
6. Re-read tasks.md to confirm your group's checkboxes are now all `- [x]`.
7. Determine whether ANY task group still has unchecked sub-tasks. Output ONLY a single JSON object:
   - If more groups remain: {"done": false, "applied_group": <group number you just completed>, "note": "<short summary of what you implemented>"}
   - If all groups complete: {"done": true, "applied_group": <group number you just completed>, "note": "all task groups complete"}

Guardrails: pause-and-report blockers honestly rather than guessing (surface them in "note"); never fabricate passing checks; keep edits minimal and scoped; always update tasks.md checkboxes.

{reflexion}
